**DRAFT • Negotiable • Not effective until executed by both parties**
This schedule supplements the signed master services agreement (MSA) and statement of work (SOW). Resolve conflicts expressly in the signed agreement; no marketing estimate, dashboard or draft creates a binding service commitment. Obtain qualified legal review before use.

## 2. Covered services and boundaries
List each covered service, system/environment, owner, scope, dependencies, agreed deliverables, baseline and acceptance criteria. Identify excluded systems and work. ## 4. Severity and service targets
| Severity | Definition | Initial response target | Update cadence | Restoration / workaround objective |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | Covered critical production service unusable; no reasonable workaround | [agreed] | [agreed] | [agreed] |
| P2 | Material degradation; business impact with limited workaround | [agreed] | [agreed] | [agreed] |
| P3 | Limited defect, noncritical issue, workaround available | [agreed] | [agreed] | [agreed] |
| P4 | Advice, enhancement or routine request | [agreed] | [agreed] | [agreed] |
Response means acknowledgment and triage, not resolution. Targets are not guarantees unless expressly negotiated. Define measurement start, covered-hours clock, pause conditions (documented client/vendor dependencies), escalation and closure evidence. Never pause an incident without recording the reason and informing the client. Security incidents follow separate notification obligations.

## 6. Security, privacy and AI governance
Approved systems, data categories, authorized access, human approvals, retention/deletion, incident notification, vendor agreements and regulated-data requirements: [ ]. No credentials or confidential records in ordinary intake. Document customer-owned accounts, least privilege, testing, rollback and escalation. AI-generated outputs require appropriate validation; no blanket guarantee of correctness. Identify applicable data processing terms/BAA separately where required.

## 7. Client and ATG responsibilities
ATG: perform scoped work, document changes and incidents, provide agreed reports, protect authorized data, escalate blockers. Client: provide lawful access, accurate information, decision owners, timely approvals, vendor subscriptions and acceptance feedback. Allocate responsibility for hosting, backups, licenses, integrations and business decisions explicitly.
